content: The legal mechanism that permits transferring customer data outside the European Economic Area (EEA) is the use of **Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)**. These clauses must be executed (along with a valid Data Processing Agreement and verification that the destination country provides adequate data‑protection standards) to lawfully move EU‑origin data abroad. 【TRUSTED SOURCE (VERIFIED) - Official Policy Standard: Cross-Border Data Transfers & SCCs】【TRUSTED SOURCE (VERIFIED) - Regulatory Compliance Guidelines - Cross-Border Data Transfers & SCCs】
